name: Codefile
description_en:
Codefile is a browser-based collaborative snippet editor for pair programming, interviews and teaching. Users share a file link and edit together; it does not compile or execute code.

Its official FAQ makes link visibility and signed-in ownership important. This is a narrower tool than the directory’s earlier debugger or full-IDE labels suggest.
description_zh:
Codefile 是用于结对编程、面试及教学的浏览器协作片段编辑器。用户分享文件链接并共同编辑，不提供编译或执行。

官方 FAQ 特别涉及链接可见性及登录创建时的所有权，范围比旧目录中的调试器或完整 IDE 标签更窄。

core_features.explanation_en: Select a language for highlighting, not execution.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选语言进行高亮，不是执行。
登录创建者可管理保护／删除。

sources.title: Codefile — Share collaborative code snippets online⚡️
sources.research_notes_en: Actual feature/FAQ page read: collaborative snippets, link visibility, no execution, signed-in-created ownership controls. Earlier directory debugger/completion/chat labels not adopted.

sources.title: Codefile — Share collaborative code snippets online⚡️
sources.research_notes_en: Same official homepage reached via FAQ anchor; explicit free-for-everyone/forever statement and voluntary donation. Same page, not independent evidence; sustained service availability not tested.

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Use a harmless snippet and a separate runtime
sections.title_zh: 使用无敏感信息的片段及独立运行环境
sections.en: For evaluation, prepare a harmless function, share its link and compare edits from two sessions. Run tests in a separate development environment: syntax highlighting does not prove correctness. No file or session was created here; collision handling and recovery remain untested.
sections.zh: 建议评估准备无敏感信息函数，分享链接并比较两会话改动。在独立开发环境运行测试，语法高亮不能证明正确。本次未创建文件／会话，冲突处理及恢复未测试。

sections.title_en: Protected is not a private readership guarantee
sections.title_zh: Protected 不能证明私密阅读
sections.en: The FAQ allows anyone holding a link to view the file. Protected restricts modification; changing it or deleting requires the creator who made the file while signed in. Anonymous creation therefore does not establish later owner control. Avoid confidential content and confirm ownership before relying on these controls.
sections.zh: FAQ 允许持链接者查看。Protected 限制修改，切换它或删除文件需由登录创建该文件的创建者操作。因此匿名创建不能证明日后拥有管理权。应避免机密内容，依赖控制前确认所有权。

sections.title_en: Free use does not establish an open-source license
sections.title_zh: 免费使用不能证明开源许可
sections.en: The official page says use is free and invites voluntary donations. Its indefinite file-retention statement is a vendor promise, not a tested backup or SLA. Full platform licensing, export, limits and recovery remain unknown.
sections.zh: 官方页面称免费使用，并接受自愿捐赠。无限期保留文件是提供方承诺，不是实测备份或 SLA。完整平台许可、导出、限制及恢复未知。
